versions.subject: added rule to detect suspicious named pipe connections to an AD FS server
versions.detection:
selection:
    PipeName: '\MICROSOFT##WID\tsql\query'
filter:
    Image|endswith:
        - 'Microsoft.IdentityServer.ServiceHost.exe'
        - 'Microsoft.Identity.Health.Adfs.PshSurrogate.exe'
        - 'AzureADConnect.exe'
        - 'Microsoft.Tri.Sensor.exe'
        - 'wsmprovhost.exe'
        - 'mmc.exe'
        - 'sqlservr.exe'
condition: selection and not filter
